inputs.prompt: Requested framing: Over shoulder. Edit the reference photograph into a new camera shot of the SAME scene. Preserve the exact same person and facial identity, hair, outfit, bag, object design, materials, lighting and set architecture from the reference. Change camera position and framing as requested; do not simply repeat the reference composition. OVER THE SHOULDER photograph: camera diagonally behind and slightly above the same fictional adult woman from the reference, with the same light chestnut chin-length wavy bob, the same mustard canvas field coat with flap chest pockets, metal buttons and shoulder tabs, and the same chunky teal cable-knit scarf wrapped as a snug cowl. Her shoulder, scarf and the back of her head fill the LEFT THIRD of the foreground. Look past her shoulder down at her two hands holding the exact same brass compass as the reference: the same deep round polished brass case with its plain round brass lid hinged open behind the dial, a clear glass cover, a plain cream dial with only four large black serif capital letters, N at the top, E on the right, S at the bottom and W on the left, a fine ring of degree ticks at the edge, and exactly one straight needle, red north half and silver south half, on a small brass pivot. No compass rose and no other printing; the dial is readable. Same rainy greenhouse with dark green window grid, wooden planters and ferns, same soft daylight.. Keep only elements visible in this framing; do not force a face into a detail or rear view.
